structure.short_leg: 5 standard QQQ puts, abs(delta) nearest 0.10 in (0.04, 0.16), same expiry, lower strike
structure.entry_alignment: Select contracts from session t snapshot; use only those same IDs at session t+1 snapshot; no replacement if quote/size is invalid.
structure.position_cadence: Fixed, non-overlapping expiry-spaced cohort so exit policies share identical entry episodes; not a continuous re-entry portfolio strategy.
structure.reference_nav_note: Normalization only; not verified current account NAV.

event_study.critical_timing_caveat: Threshold events are EOD quote-mark events, not intraday threshold touches. Source reports 16:00 ET; exact tick timestamp and fill availability are unverified.
event_study.interpretation_rule: These are conditional historical diagnostics, not causal proof or a forecast; small event counts remain inconclusive.

performance_gate: BLOCKED_FOR_DEPLOYMENT: EOD timing/fills unverified, broker margin/assignment costs unavailable, one-unit 1x5 tail risk may exceed reference NAV, and history is previously inspected development data.
limitations: This is a short-ratio put structure: one higher-strike long put only offsets one of the five lower-strike short puts. The remaining four short puts create severe downside exposure.
Zero-underlying tail loss is terminal intrinsic arithmetic; it does not model interim volatility expansion, margin calls, forced liquidation, execution gaps, or broker-specific margin.
All exit triggers are EOD quote-mark rules; the dataset does not establish intraday touches or fills.
Missing option marks are never forward-filled. A missing quote can defer a close action; unresolved trades do not enter closed-P&L totals.
Intrinsic expiry settlement is a proxy before broker exercise/assignment fees, taxes, or operational frictions.
